rules.statement: In a test project, a mock-setup helper needed by several test classes lives in one shared internal helper (such as an extension method on the mock type) with a single signature, not as diverging private copies in each test class.
rules.why: A fix to one private copy doesn't reach the others, and copies with different signatures leave readers unsure which one is the pattern to follow.
rules.check: Look for the same private helper method (same name or same body) being added to a test class when copies already exist in other test classes, especially with different parameter lists.

rules.statement: In Markdown documentation, keep an inline code span on a single line; when wrapping prose, break before or after the span, or use a fenced code block for long snippets.
rules.why: Markdown renders a line break inside a code span as a space, so the snippet no longer matches the code it describes and copying it requires rejoining it by hand.
rules.check: In changed .md files, look for a backtick code span that opens on one line and closes on the next.
